title: WPRS – Whisper Position Reporting System
description: How a 200 mW WSPR transmitter with GPS and a car-roof 14 MHz antenna reports its position over HF without any mobile or VHF coverage; design, position accuracy, availability, power and battery measurements.

title: Twenty-metre WSPR propagation study
description: Scientific analysis of 166 days of logged WSPR data: diurnal and seasonal patterns, geography, long-distance windows and the effect of MUF, K-index and solar flux.
